reason: A compatibility bridge that reuses Claude Code rules, skills, agents, and command hooks in DeepSeek Harness without copying source assets; its documented hook execution and explicit external references warrant R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 的规则、技能、代理定义和命令钩子以只读方式接入 DeepSeek Harness，并通过项目配置提供可选适配。
summaries.en: A read-only compatibility bridge that exposes Claude Code rules, skills, agent definitions, and command hooks to DeepSeek Harness with optional project-specific adaptations.

capabilities: Reads project and user Claude configuration files
Registers and invokes skills and agent definitions
Bridges lifecycle command hooks to DSH events
Executes shell commands defined by project or user hooks
Follows explicit skill and agent symlinks and rule imports
